content: Added a `start_documentation` MCP prompt (packages/documentation-mcp/src/prompts/startDocumentation.ts), registered in src/index.ts via server.registerPrompt alongside the existing server.registerTool loop. It takes no arguments and returns a single user-role instructional message walking the calling agent through the full onboarding flow in order: detect_ai_dir -> (init_ai_scaffold / migration / upgrade_ai_dir depending on status) -> ask the user what to document -> scan_project -> ask the user its open_questions plus anything else noticed missing (never guess) -> record_evidence for every answer/inference -> list_evidence -> write_doc/write_context_chunk -> get_setup_status summary. Tested in test/start-documentation-prompt.test.ts (checks it requires no args, mentions every tool in the flow, and tells the agent to ask rather than guess).
